coverage.strategy: Deterministic projection of every reviewed engine source node, preserving source edition, access, reference status and explicit navigation bindings.
mappedAreas: All 119 reviewed source nodes, including documented access level 3 options.
Reference-only, PC, hardware and unsupported operations remain visibly distinct from supported simulation.
9 authored practice tasks, separate from the manufacturer menu tree.
excludedAreas: All events, zone labels, device-work acknowledgements and timings are fictional training data.
Zone disablement ignores all inputs in that zone; Zone Status OFF is a separate installer supply-off setting. There is no addressed-device enrolment menu.
Level3A permits engineer review; programming changes require the exposed Write Enable switch at3B and a system reset to take effect. Operator disable/test actions are separate.
Exact alphanumeric multi-tap timing, external input electrical effects, peripheral supervision, unavailable panel networking and printer functionality remain reference-only.
Source System Test description duplicates local audible test; no all-zone sound pattern is inferred. Peripheral ON/OFF examples repeat option numbers; no guessed numeric sequence is supplied.
The training clock advances only through labelled assists. Approximately five-second walk-test reset is a source approximation, not measured firmware timing.
Display contents and post-reset view continuity are illustrative; source menus, physical keys, choices and access boundaries are retained.
coverage.confidence: Manufacturer-manual-backed reference and fictional practice. No hardware or firmware certification.
